applies_why: The judge text addresses whether witnesses from earlier rounds were answered and therefore not counted under K-G4.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge identifies those witnesses as answered and does not count any of them as an unanswered witness, so it complies with K-G4.
